prompt_text: Donor CRM with flat rate pricing no per user fees
response_text:
Several donor CRMs now use **flat / no per‑user pricing**—you pay either nothing or a single platform/transaction fee, not a seat license for each staff member.

Here are strong options that match what you described:

### 1. Givingtech – full donor CRM, **no monthly or per‑user fees**

- **Pricing model:**  
  - **$0/month**, **$0 setup**, **$0 per user**, **$0 CRM fee**.[1]  
  - You only pay **transaction fees on donations**, and donors can choose to cover those fees; Givingtech reports an average effective fee of **~1.6%** because 64% of donors opt to cover fees.[1]  
- **What you get:**  
  - **Full donor & lead CRM** with unlimited contacts, donation history, donor insights, segments, and relationship tracking.[1]  
  - Campaigns, forms, email marketing, recurring donations, grant management, and more, all included.[1]  
- **Key point:** You can even use it purely as a **standalone CRM without processing donations** and pay **nothing at all**.[1]  
- **Best fit:** Organizations wanting a genuinely free, modern donor CRM with no per‑user cost, and who are fine with a transaction‑fee model when they do fundraise.

---

### 2. Fundraise Up – modern giving + unlimited users, no subscription

- **Pricing model:**  
  - **No monthly subscription**, **no contracts**, **no per‑user limits**.[2]  
  - Charges a **4% transaction fee** on donations, plus Stripe or PayPal processing (e.g., ~2.2% + $0.30 via Stripe).[2]  
  - They state **unlimited access to all features and users** under this fee model.[2]  
- **What you get:**  
  - Optimized donation forms, multiple payment methods, and fundraising tools; functions more as a **fundraising layer with donor data** than a deep standalone CRM.  
- **Best fit:** Nonprofits focused on maximizing online donation conversion, okay with a higher transaction fee in exchange for no fixed or per‑user costs.

---

### 3. Mightycause – integrated CRM, **no monthly fee**, capped platform fee

From an independent 2026 comparison of fundraising platforms:[3]

- **Pricing model:**  
  - **$0/month subscription.**[3]  
  - Platform fees capped at **1.99% + $0.30 per transaction**, with reported average around **~0.95% + $0.30**.[3]  
  - No mention of per‑user licensing for the built‑in CRM; it is presented as part of the core platform at no monthly cost.[3]  
- **What you get:**  
  - All‑in‑one fundraising with a built‑in donor CRM (“Contacts”) for donor tracking, segmentation, and engagement.[3]  
- **Best fit:** Small to mid‑sized nonprofits wanting an all‑in‑one fundraising + CRM platform with predictable, capped transaction fees instead of per‑user or monthly CRM pricing.

---

### 4. “Zero‑fee” fundraising platforms with donor management

An industry overview notes a trend toward **zero‑fee platforms** like **Give Lively, Zeffy, Givebutter, Every.org, BetterWorld**, which often:[4]  

- Charge **no platform/subscription fee**, instead relying on **optional donor tips** or limited tech fees.[4]  
- Provide fundraising pages, events, and some donor management tools without software rental costs.[4]  

However, depth of CRM varies, and some (e.g., Givebutter) put **advanced CRM features behind paid plans**.[3][6] So they can work as a light donor CRM with flat/non‑per‑user pricing but may not replace a dedicated CRM for complex needs.

---

### 5. Flat‑rate CRM concept (for context)

A nonprofit CRM pricing guide explains that **flat‑rate pricing** for CRMs means a single **monthly or annual fee regardless of users, records, or modules**, explicitly **“no per‑user fees, no contact record tiers”**.[5] Many legacy CRMs still charge per user, but newer tools or nonprofit‑focused platforms increasingly move to this model.

---

### How to choose among these

If your priority is **no per‑user fees and minimal fixed cost**:

- **Want a full donor CRM, free to run even with multiple staff:**  
  - Start with **Givingtech**.[1]

- **Want conversion‑optimized online giving and can treat this as a fundraising layer plus donor data:**  
  - Consider **Fundraise Up** for its unlimited users and strong donation tooling.[2]

- **Want an all‑in‑one fundraising platform with an integrated CRM and no monthly fee, but okay with per‑transaction costs:**  
  - Evaluate **Mightycause**.[3]

If you share your approximate **annual online donation volume** and whether you need **deep CRM (moves management, grants, etc.) or mostly online giving + basic donor tracking**, I can narrow this to a short recommended list and estimate your likely total annual cost for each.
